# Ramenhead

> Authentic Japanese ramen in Cape Town — freshly made noodles and 48-hour broths.

Ramenhead is Cape Town's destination for authentic ramen: silky, freshly-made noodles, umami-rich broth simmered for 48 hours, and sake served in brimful glasses. Ramenhead has imported the only Yamato noodle machine in Africa and produces every noodle in-house, making it a genuinely one-of-a-kind proposition.

## Location

- **Speaker's Corner**: 37 Parliament Street, Cape Town, 8001. In the historic centre of the city.

## Hours

- Dinner: Tuesday – Saturday, 5:00 PM – 10:00 PM
- Happy Hour: Weekdays 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM (50% off all small plates and selected cocktails)
- Live music every Thursday

## Contact and bookings

- Phone / WhatsApp: +27 67 312 8061
- Email: info@ramenhead.co.za
- Reservations: https://www.dineplan.com/restaurants/ramenhead
- Walk-ins welcome. Outside seating available for walk-ins (weather dependent). Seating limited to two hours per table. No cash payments.

## The kitchen

The kitchen is led by Executive Chef Julia du Toit, with guidance from FYN Group's Peter Tempelhoff and Ashley Moss, taking its cue from the ramen shops of Japan. Authentic techniques and carefully-selected ingredients extend beyond the bowls.

## What we serve

Authentic Japanese ramen. Five signature bowls:

- **Tonkotsu** — Rich 48-hour pork bone broth. R150 / R220
- **Tofu Sesame Abura Soba** (soupless, vegan-friendly) — Sesame & mala spice. R150 / R225
- **Torched Cape Wagyu** (MS9+) — Beef broth, shoyu tare, truffled kikurage. R420
- **Tori Paitan** — Creamy chicken broth, chicken wonton, chicken chashu. R160 / R230
- **Karoo Lamb Tantanmen** — Spicy roast mince in Japanese curry broth. R150 / R225

Plus Japanese street food (okonomiyaki fries, chicken karaage), small plates, gyoza, dessert, and a bar with award-winning cocktails, local and imported beers, and sake served from traditional masu cups.

Vegan and vegetarian options are available. We can accommodate most dietary needs with prior notice, but **not severe, fatal, or allium/garlic allergies**.

## Common questions

- **Where are you?** Speaker's Corner, 37 Parliament Street, Cape Town.
- **Do you take reservations?** Yes, via Dineplan. Walk-ins also welcome, with outside seating (weather dependent). Seating is limited to two hours per table.
- **Do you have vegan options?** Yes — Tofu Sesame Abura Soba and several small plates.
- **Do you take cash?** No. Card and EFT only.
- **Is there a happy hour?** Weekdays 5–7 PM, 50% off all small plates and selected cocktails.
- **Is there live music?** Yes, every Thursday.
- **What makes the noodles special?** Every noodle is made in-house on the only Yamato noodle machine in Africa.
